license: Composer core/API: no reusable official source license found; treat as proprietary. The unaffiliated SolarWolf-Code/composer-trade-py repository has an actual MIT LICENSE, but its README calls it unofficial; composer-trade-common has no LICENSE in its visible top-level tree.
methods: Conditional absolute momentum: cumulativeReturn(SPY, 20 trading days) > 0.02 selects SPY; otherwise BND, independently implemented and PAPER-only.
Cross-sectional momentum: rank a declared universe by 90-day cumulative return and select topN=3; Composer's public illustration names SQ, SPOT, NFLX, AAPL, SHOP, and TWLO.

Inverse-volatility weighting: independently implement w_i=(1/sigma_i)/sum(1/sigma_j), with Zax-selected trailing daily-return windows such as 20, 60, or 126 bars; Composer does not document its estimator/window.
Cost-sensitive backtest controls: capital, start/end dates, benchmarks, fee switches, slippage and spread inputs; Composer documents slippage_percent as decimal and spread_markup 0.001 as 10 bp.
Optional read-only research discovery: authenticated POST /api/v0.1/search/symphonies can return public-symphony metadata and OOS performance statistics; do not copy logic or deploy/trade.
name: Composer and Composer API
reuseDecision: No vendor-code reuse and no default API integration. Implement the published rule concepts independently in Zax. Only consider an off-by-default server-side reference mode for public-symphony metadata after explicit terms review; never expose a Composer key in Expo and never permit account, deployment, backtest, dry-run, or trading routes.
requirements: Composer API access requires a Composer account, Pro plan, Key ID, and bearer Secret; Pro is listed at $384/year, billed as $32/month yearly.
Keep any Composer Secret in a user-controlled server-side secret store; Composer documents one active key tied to the creator's account access and does not document read-only scopes.

For independent Zax implementations, use a permitted adjusted daily-bar data source with corporate-action and symbol handling. Composer's documented market data does not establish historical equity OHLCV or L2 availability.

For exact Composer backtests, paid Pro access is necessary but insufficient: public docs do not disclose the price-history method, universe treatment, signal timing, or inverse-volatility lookback/estimator.
Use 25 requests/minute per API key and endpoint as the conservative cap because the API docs and onboarding article conflict; the claimed public 500-request/second backtest endpoint is not verified.
Review the current rendered API terms directly and obtain vendor confirmation before production use; substantive terms text was dynamically inaccessible to text fetch.
